# VoiceLayer (`Comandvoice` v0.6.0-vnext) — Universal Symbiotic Voice & Agent Layer

> Drop-in, zero-dependency voice & conversational operating layer (`public/voicelayer/voicelayer.js`) that lives on top of **any website or web application**, absorbs its DOM and runtime state, learns each user's behavior in isolated per-user profiles, answers any question about the site or user, and executes voice commands across all links, buttons, forms, and workflows.

## 1. How Another Developer or AI Agent Integrates VoiceLayer Into Any Website (Symbiotic Handshake)

Drop the script tag into any HTML template or SPA entry (`index.html`):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/voicelayer/voicelayer.css" />
<script
  src="/voicelayer/voicelayer.js"
  data-appid="your-app-id"
  data-Position="bottom-right"
  data-theme="dark"
  data-knowledge="true"
  data-forms="true"
  defer></script>
```

### Option A: One-Call Runtime Symbiotic Handshake (Recommended for React / Next.js / Vue / SPAs)

In your root component or auth/store effect, publish `window.__VOICELAYER_SYMBIOSIS__` and call `window.VoiceLayer?.symbiosis?.handshake(...)`:

```js
const symbiosisSpec = {
  appName: 'Your Web App Name',
  userId: currentUser.id, // Isolates behavioral learning & memory per user in localStorage
  profile: {
    id: currentUser.id,
    name: currentUser.name,
    role: currentUser.role,
    goals: currentUser.goals,
    readiness: { score: 82, status: 'Optimal', message: 'Ready for high-output focus' },
    metrics: {
      sleep: { current: 7.8 },
      hrv: { current: 68 },
      rhr: { current: 52 }
    },
    biologicalAge: 34.2,
    biomarkers: 'ApoB 62 mg/dL, hs-CRP 0.4 mg/L, VO2 Max 54.2',
    trainingPlan: { todaysWorkout: 'Zone 2 Ride (45 min)', recommendedIntensity: 'Moderate' },
    nutrition: { dailyCalorieTarget: 2600, macros: { proteinGrams: 180, carbsGrams: 250, fatGrams: 80 } }
  },
  // Calendar 1: Primary / Clinical / Personal Appointments
  calendar: [
    { title: 'Dr. Chen follow-up (labs review)', time: '09:00', location: 'Telehealth', kind: 'medical' }
  ],
  // Calendar 2: Work Meetings, Training Sessions & Business Trips / Flights
  workCalendar: [
    { title: 'Weekly review — Performance Board', time: '15:00', location: 'Zoom', kind: 'work' },
    { title: 'Zone 2 Active Recovery Ride — 45 min', time: '18:30', location: 'Key Biscayne', kind: 'training' },
    { title: 'NYC Summit Flight & Circadian Prep', time: 'Tomorrow 07:30', location: 'MIA -> JFK', kind: 'trip' }
  ],
  // Pending to Take (Supplements / Medications / Tasks)
  toTake: [
    { name: 'Liposomal NAD+ Precursor', dose: '500mg', time: 'Morning', taken: false }
  ],
  // Pending to Buy (Low-supply Refills / Reorders / Shopping List)
  toBuy: [
    { name: 'Magnesium L-Threonate', daysRemaining: 4, price: '$54', status: 'low' }
  ],
  // Product Catalog / Inventory
  inventory: [
    { id: 'sku-1', name: 'Liposomal NAD+', price: '$88.00', value: 88, category: 'Longevity', inStock: true }
  ],
  // Site & Domain Knowledge Q&A Passages
  knowledge: [
    { heading: 'Platform Overview', text: 'Description of what the platform does, policies, shipping, etc.' }
  ],
  // Custom Voice-Callable Host Actions
  actions: [
    {
      name: 'bookConsultation',
      phrases: ['book consultation', 'schedule doctor call'],
      description: 'Opens the telemedicine booking modal',
      handler: () => openBookingModal()
    }
  ]
};

window.__VOICELAYER_SYMBIOSIS__ = symbiosisSpec;
window.VoiceLayer?.symbiosis?.handshake?.(symbiosisSpec);
```

### Option B: Zero-JS Declarative DOM Attributes (Works on Any Static HTML / SSR / Shopify / WordPress Site)

VoiceLayer's `Scanner`, `Briefing`, and `Knowledge` engines automatically absorb HTML attributes without writing any JavaScript:
- **Primary Calendar:** `<div data-vl-calendar="Dr. Chen Follow-up" data-vl-time="09:00" data-vl-location="Telehealth"></div>`
- **Second Calendar (Work / Training / Trips):** `<div data-vl-work-calendar="NYC Summit Flight" data-vl-kind="trip" data-vl-time="Tomorrow 07:30" data-vl-location="MIA -> JFK"></div>`
- **Pending to Take:** `<div data-vl-take="NAD+ Precursor" data-vl-dose="500mg" data-vl-taken="false"></div>`
- **Pending to Buy:** `<div data-vl-buy="Magnesium L-Threonate" data-vl-days-left="4"></div>`
- **Domain Q&A Fact:** `<div data-vl-qa-q="How does cold-chain shipping work?" data-vl-qa-a="All peptides ship in insulated 2-8°C medical coolers."></div>`
- **Declarative JSON Manifest:** `<script type="application/voicelayer+json">{ ...symbiosisSpec }</script>`

## 2. Multi-User Learning & Storage Isolation

When a website is used by multiple users, clients, or athletes:
- Calling `VoiceLayer.setUser(userId, profile)` (or passing `userId` in `symbiosis.handshake`) isolates that user's profile and behavioral learning under `localStorage["voicelayer.profile.v1:<userId>"]` and registers the user in `localStorage["voicelayer.users.v1"]`.
- Check active and known users anytime via `VoiceLayer.profile.activeUserId` and `VoiceLayer.users`.

## 3. Self-Diagnostic Inspection for Developers & AI Agents

Run in browser console:
- `VoiceLayer.symbiosis.status()` — returns connection health across profile, biometrics, primary calendar, work/training/trip calendar, pending to take/buy, inventory, knowledge passages, and interactive DOM controls.
- `VoiceLayer.symbiosis.guide()` — returns the built-in quick-reference contract.
